# docs

## Documentation Sets

- [docs](https://webext-core.aklinker1.io/webext-core.aklinker1.io/llms-full.txt)

## Landing

- [Web extension development made easy](https://webext-core.aklinker1.io/webext-core.aklinker1.io): A collection of easy-to-use utilities for writing and testing web extensions that work on all browsers.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://webext-core.aklinker1.io/webext-core.aklinker1.io/get-started/introduction): Use packages from NPM or download them from a CDN.
- [Browser Support](https://webext-core.aklinker1.io/webext-core.aklinker1.io/get-started/browser-support): What browsers do WebExt Core's packages support? All of them.
- [Contributing](https://webext-core.aklinker1.io/webext-core.aklinker1.io/get-started/contributing): Special thanks to the contributors. I look forward to seeing you in the list!
